Gold edges higher as traders ease Fed rate-hike bets after Warsh speech
events.summary: Bloomberg reported gold edged higher as traders pared bets on a Fed rate hike following a speech by Fed Chair Kevin Warsh.

events.title: US import prices post largest annual gain in more than four years
events.summary: US import prices rose in September, posting their largest year-on-year increase in more than four years, adding to inflation pressure after the hot CPI print.

events.title: Dollar retreats from 18-month high as Fed's Bowman and Daly temper hike bets
events.summary: The dollar index slipped to about 102.06 after the hot CPI pushed it to an 18-month high; Bowman and Daly said the Fed can wait for a clearer picture before the Oct 27-28 meeting, and the 10-year yield fell to a three-week low near 5.13%.

events.title: US September PPI jumps 6.3% y/y, biggest annual gain since 2022
events.summary: US producer prices rose 1.3% m/m and 6.3% y/y in September (from 5.6% in August), versus about 0.6% and 5.5% expected; energy from the Middle East conflict drove the jump. Core PPI ex food, energy and trade rose 0.5% m/m and 5% y/y.

events.title: Gold stalls below $4,200 as Fed rate-hike bets limit upside
events.summary: Gold held below $4,200 an ounce on Monday as bets on Fed rate hikes after hot inflation data capped gains.

events.title: US September CPI comes in hot at about 3.7%; October Fed hike odds jump to about 47%
events.summary: Energy-driven inflation lifted rate-hike bets from about 20%. S&P 500 fell 0.6%, chipmakers led losses; 10-year yield near 5.33%.

events.title: Hassett says September CPI shows inflation 'needs some work'
events.summary: White House economic adviser Kevin Hassett said the latest CPI data show inflation still needs work, as strong spending complicates the Fed's path.

events.title: Scotiabank and BMO now expect a 25 bp Bank of Canada hike next week
events.summary: After September CPI rose to 3.1%, Scotiabank and BMO both said they expect the Bank of Canada to raise rates by 25 bp at next week's decision; BoC surveys also showed higher inflation expectations.

events.title: US budget deficit swells to almost $2 trillion for fiscal 2026, up 12%
events.summary: The US federal budget deficit for fiscal 2026 rose about 12% to almost $2 trillion, with net interest costs around $1.1 trillion, adding to worries about Treasury supply as 10-year-plus yields sit near 5%.

events.title: US Treasury yields move lower as investors assess the inflation backdrop
events.summary: US Treasury yields fell on Monday as investors weighed the US inflation outlook and easing oil prices, with Fed hike fears receding.

events.title: Kenya confirms eighth Ebola case amid widening regional outbreak
events.summary: Kenya confirmed an eighth Ebola case, up from seven reported on Oct 17, as the outbreak that began with a patient from DR Congo widens in the region.

events.title: Gold heads for a weekly drop as traders assess Fed signals
events.summary: Gold was set for a weekly loss as traders weighed Fed signals, after the year's biggest rally stalled; silver also fell over the week.

events.title: Indian fund houses halt fresh inflows into gold ETF fund-of-funds on SEBI instructions
events.summary: Indian asset managers stopped accepting fresh money into gold ETF fund-of-funds schemes after instructions from regulator SEBI, Cafemutual reported.

events.title: Fed's Goolsbee calls hot September inflation reading discouraging
events.summary: Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee said the hotter-than-expected September CPI was discouraging but he wants more data before acting to raise rates.

events.title: Fed Chair Warsh withholds rate signal as Fed officials cool October hike bets
events.summary: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh gave no signal on the next rate move while praising recent global tightening with 'no free riders'; crypto press reports Fed officials cooled October hike bets, with Bitcoin near $82,000. Headline-level facts; search index lagged.

events.title: Euro falls and European stocks drop as French unrest and high energy prices weigh
events.summary: The euro slipped and the Stoxx index fell at the open as violent cost-of-living protests in France and high energy prices weighed on sentiment.

events.title: China's yuan hits four-year high as strong GDP data ease stimulus concerns
events.summary: The yuan rose to a four-year high against the dollar after China's Q3 GDP grew 4.5%, beating forecasts; the PBOC also set a stronger midpoint fixing.

events.title: Treasury and eurozone bond yields fall to multiweek lows as US inflation shock fades
events.summary: WSJ and CNBC report US Treasury and eurozone yields falling to multiweek lows on 15 Oct as the hot September CPI shock fades and a tech sell-off fuels safe-haven demand.

events.title: Gold and silver rebound on softer dollar and falling yields
events.summary: Gold and silver rebounded as the dollar softened and bond yields fell; Indian domestic gains were capped by a stronger rupee.

events.title: Indian mutual funds stop bulk subscriptions to gold ETFs ahead of festive season
events.summary: Indian fund houses have stopped bulk subscriptions to gold ETFs ahead of the festive season, Mint reported, extending curbs that began in June as the government tries to limit gold imports and support the rupee.

Cuts and stimulus made it the fastest recovery as well.
